items.title: Last week, we explored Schnorr Proofs of Knowledge. Tonight, we go deeper into ECDSA and see exactly why nonce reuse is so dangerous.
items.text: Last week, we explored Schnorr Proofs of Knowledge. Tonight, we go deeper into ECDSA and see exactly why nonce reuse is so dangerous. A 256-bit private key can be protected by some of the most sophisticated mathematics in Bitcoin. But reuse one nonce & the math can give the private key back. We’ll break down: • Fiat-Shamir: How interactive proofs become signatures • ECDSA: The signing equation, security properties, and its evolution toward Schnorr and Taproot • Nonce Reuse: How two signatures can reveal the private key, step by step Join the Cryptographic Foundations of Bitcoin club tonight at 8 PM IST with host @sha512rma. 📍8 PM only on Discord:

items.title: New Bitcoin Talks episode with @Basanta_Goswami just dropped.
items.text: New Bitcoin Talks episode with @Basanta_Goswami just dropped. How do we build truly private, self-custodial software for a Bitcoin-native future? In this episode of Bitshala Talks, we sit down with open-source developer Basanta to unpack the technical reality of building freedom tech. Key takeaways from the conversation: Reproducible Builds: Why verifying software binaries from source code is critical for wallet security. Bull Bitcoin: The philosophy behind self-custodial exchanges & mobile wallet architecture at @BULLBITCOIN_ Privacy-First Education: Bringing non-bitcoiners into freedom tech through community initiatives like Cyber Suraj at Bitspace @bitshala. L2 Trade-Offs: Breaking down Lightning, @Liquid_BTC federations, & @arc for scalable self-custody. Open-Source Dev: How to contribute meaningfully to Bitcoin repositories. Watch the full interview here 👇

items.text: How can reusing a single random number lead to the loss of your Bitcoin private key? ⚡️ Last week, we explored the Schnorr Proof of Knowledge. Today, we move from theory to practice and see how that interactive protocol becomes a non-interactive digital signature scheme. Join the Cryptographic Foundations of Bitcoin club, every Thursday at 8 PM, with host @sha512rma. We’ll cover: 🔹 Schnorr Interactive Proof: Proving ownership of a secret without revealing it 🔹 Fiat-Shamir Transform: How hashing removes the need for interaction 🔹 Nonce Reuse Catastrophe: How poor randomness can expose a private key 📍 8 PM only on Discord:
